title: Broad-Disc Bent-Stem Sunflower
description: One newly authored whole stylised sunflower crop appearance: a slightly bent stem supports a broad forward-inclined dark shallow-domed flower disc within a thick green receptacle and a ring of individually thick folded pointed golden ray petals. Two genuinely serrated cordate leaves with finite upper/lower surfaces grow from separate bent petioles. Not an extracted old planter flower, recolored maize or a petal-count variant: the complete head volume, elongated folded rays, backing and broad notched serrated leaf construction are newly authored. Metres Z up, true whole XY bounds-centred, stem-base sole at Z0; opaque PBR, no alpha cards. One static prop, no scenery. No botanical species/cultivar precision, counted seeds, growth, yield, wind/animation, ecology, physical stability or food-use claims.
